name: How much does an office build-out cost per square foot in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much should I budget per square foot for an office build-out in Los Angeles if I want private offices, a conference room, and a break area?
mainEntity.text: How much should I budget per square foot for an office build-out in Los Angeles if I want private offices, a conference room, and a break area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Office build-out cost in Los Angeles depends on the existing condition of the space, the number of rooms, finish level, and how much electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and fire protection work is required. A simple refresh costs far less than a full tenant improvement with private offices, conference rooms, reception, pantry, and upgraded lighting. In many LA projects, mid-tier office TI lands roughly in the $80 to $180 per square foot range, while high-end spaces can exceed that when custom finishes or complex systems are involved. The fastest way to avoid budget surprises is to get a scope-based estimate rather than a generic square-foot number. Ask bidders to separate demolition, framing, MEP, finishes, permits, and contingency so you can compare apples to apples. For older buildings in Glendale, Pasadena, or North Hollywood, hidden upgrade costs can change the total significantly. Always carry contingency for plan-check revisions, utility upgrades, and long lead times on specialty materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most Los Angeles office build-outs fall into broad tiers: basic cosmetic work is lower, mid-range offices with partitions and meeting rooms cost more, and high-end finishes with custom millwork and AV cost the most. Realistic budgets often start around $80 to $180 per square foot for mid-tier office TI and can rise well above that for premium builds.
